planted_relationships.name: Attendance to Marks
planted_relationships.description: Higher student attendance is associated with higher marks.
planted_relationships.mechanism: Diligence trait increases attendance probability via diligence_attendance_weight; ability trait increases marks via ability_marks_weight; diligence and ability are positively correlated latent traits.

planted_relationships.name: LMS Engagement to Marks
planted_relationships.description: Higher LMS event count is associated with higher marks, with strength varying by school.
planted_relationships.mechanism: Engagement trait scales base event frequency and attendance; school lms_activity multipliers (CET highest at 1.40, SOL lowest at 0.85) modulate event volume; engagement correlates with ability.

planted_relationships.name: Late Submission Rate to Marks
planted_relationships.description: Higher rate of late coursework submissions is associated with lower marks.
planted_relationships.mechanism: Diligence trait reduces late submission probability via diligence_late_weight; higher diligence correlates with higher ability and higher marks.

planted_relationships.name: Quiz Attempts to Marks
planted_relationships.description: Higher quiz activity and attempts are associated with higher marks.
planted_relationships.mechanism: Diligence and school quiz_activity multipliers drive assessment engagement and multiple attempts; diligent students achieve higher marks.

planted_relationships.name: Course Difficulty Confounder
planted_relationships.description: Course difficulty acts as a confounding factor shifting marks and attendance jointly across courses.
planted_relationships.mechanism: Course difficulty level applies downward shifts to marks (-8 / -16) and attendance (-0.05 / -0.10); within-course z-scoring in J4 is required to isolate true student traits from course difficulty effects.

decoy_relationship.name: Forum Activity to Marks (Decoy)
decoy_relationship.description: No intentionally planted relationship between forum activity and marks; serves as a negative control for recovery testing.
decoy_relationship.mechanism: Forum posts and replies are generated as general LMS activity without a specific coupling to ability or diligence, so recovery analytics must confirm no significant association.

metadata.description: Synthetic ground-truth registry established prior to analytical observation.
metadata.analytical_interpretation: Acadexa measures statistical association, not causation (rules.md §8, memory.md §8).
